Explanation: The Product Listing is the Core Value Unit: a supplier offer describing a product, specification, price range, minimum order quantity and sourcing terms that a business Buyer can discover and negotiate.
Alibaba.com operates the global B2B marketplace and is part of Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group.
Alibaba.com reduces the friction of discovering, evaluating and transacting with business suppliers across borders.
More Buyers and Suppliers reinforce marketplace liquidity and create demand for membership, marketing, transaction and trade services.
B2B marketplace growth is constrained when Buyers cannot trust supplier quality, payment security, shipment or dispute resolution.
Alibaba.com coordinates discovery and negotiation and, through Trade Assurance, can add escrow, protection and dispute support to the transaction.
Transaction Flows: ← Consumer · Order / Pay — Business Buyers place protected orders and payment through Alibaba.com when using its transaction flow. | → Consumer · Match / Protect — Alibaba.com provides supplier discovery, transaction infrastructure and Trade Assurance protections for eligible orders. | ← Provider · Listing / Data — Suppliers provide product listings, company information, quotes and commercial data to the marketplace. | → Provider · Leads / Payout — Alibaba.com connects Suppliers with buyer demand and releases protected payment when applicable conditions are satisfied. | ← Partner · Services — Trade-service actors contribute payments, logistics, inspection and other capabilities. | → Partner · Volume / Data — Marketplace orders and transaction data create service volume for integrated trade-service partners.
